name: Dark Reader
summary: Generates dynamic dark themes for any site via several filter modes, with per-site controls and system-dark-mode sync, useful for previewing forced-dark rendering.
license: MIT (GitHub repo darkreader/darkreader); the store page additionally requires agreement to darkreader.org terms of use on install.
goodFor: Previewing how any site looks with dynamic dark themes applied.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: dark mode theme filter forced dark preview invert brightness
